name: OCV(SOC,T) + three Foster branches + directional hysteresis
sign_convention: Positive current discharges; h tends toward+1 during discharge; terminal voltage contains+H*h exactly as proposed by user. This is distinct from the older minusHh model.

equations.gamma_dir: gamma_plus forI>0;gamma_minus forI<0;I=0 givesdh/dt=0 without selecting a direction

constant_interval_transport.condition: I,T and physical parameters held on declared interval; state is continuous across sample boundaries
constant_interval_transport.stable_arithmetic: Evaluate1-exp(-x) using-expm1(-x) when appropriate; do not add diffusion or clip states to hide failed domain checks
constant_interval_transport.measurement_epoch: Endpoint voltage after interval transport; actual duration and sequence belong to the source
constant_interval_transport.varying_temperature: Producer must declare interval convention or integration and its error; the compressor does not reconstruct a temperature waveform or select a physical integrator

branch_identity: Modes retain theirR/tau/vi pairing; do not independently sort time constants or RC states. A parameter path violating the declared ordering is outside this model contract.
capacitance: Ci=taui/Ri in farads; C is derived rather than an additional independent parameter

temperature.reference_temperature: Required public calibration/model input, not fixture-derived
temperature.positive_parameter_family: p(T)=p_ref*exp(A_p*(1/T-1/T_ref));A_p has unitsK and a parameter-specific sign. For a thermally activated rate A_p=-Ea/Rgas; resistance-like quantities may use the opposite sign. No universal shared activation coefficient is assumed.
temperature.zero_parameters: H_ref=0 orR0_ref=0 remainszero under its multiplicative law; do not log-transformzero
temperature.OCV: U=a(T)+b(T)*z+r(z,T),b(T)>0; separately declared calibration and residual model. Do not automatically assignOCV the electrical coefficient law.
temperature.coefficient_authority: Thermal coefficients are characterized with declared uncertainty or learned jointly when informative; no truth parameters injected into initialization
temperature.health: Reference parameter paths may change when supported by estimator evidence; this contract prescribes no nonzero calendar/cycle drift rate

inference_consequences: Q influences bothSOC and hysteresis transport; tokens retain theircross dependence withgamma_plus/gamma_minus andH
Earliergamma inperAh converts to normalizedgamma by multiplying byQ_Ah only for a fixedQ reference; silently reusing old coefficients changes the model

With unknownlinearOCVslope and free directional gamma, scalingQ,b,gamma bylambda andz0 by1/lambda leaves the constant-parameter voltage trajectory invariant when states remain in domain. Independent calibration/anchors are needed for absoluteQ/SOC
An inferred parameter revision is epistemic; it is not a physical instantaneous charge/energy change. Genuine time-varyingQ/C needs an explicitly admitted availability/state-continuity convention
implementation: Equations and finite contract controls only; existingC plant/rolling solver and previous evidence remain unchanged
